title: Capricorn, love isn't a summit
caption: for the capricorns who answer emails at midnight

scenes.text: capricorn, put the work down for one minute.
saturn raised you on patience and deadlines.
the goat in you climbs slowly and almost never falls.
so you treat love like another mountain.
something to earn, one careful step at a time.
you show up early. you remember everything.
and you still wonder if it's enough.
but love doesn't have a summit.
no top, no flag, no view that proves you made it.
it's the person who sits with you on the ledge.
put your terms on the table, then let them in.
you've carried enough sky. let someone take a corner.
you're allowed to be loved before you're finished.
the mountain will wait. sit down a while.
